customManagers.description: The patch series: HOMESCOOP_REF pins the homescoop commit whose packages/wasi-fnox patches and crates/wasix-command are applied to jdx/fnox.
The Rust toolchain every target is built with.

packageRules.description: A new patch series or toolchain changes the binaries, so its commit is a fix and cuts a release. The release planner skips a homescoop bump that leaves the patched source tree unchanged.
homescoop main moves often; take its head once a day.
